title: Sales Enablement: Micro-assets, demo funnel scripts, and field-ready FAQ
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Produce a compact, field-friendly enablement bundle for the runtime-1.20 launch that Sales and CS can use in 5–10 minute prep windows. Bundle includes a micro-battlecard (single page), three demo-funnel scripts mapped to common customer personas, concise FAQ (top 20 Qs), two 90s video talk-track snippets, and a release-notes one-paragraph summary.
deliverables: Micro-battlecard (1 page PDF): positioning, top objections, quick counters, pricing signals
Demo funnel scripts: Cold intro -> pilot -> procurement (3 persona flows with timings)
Field FAQ (Google Doc): top 20 questions with canonical answers and links to deeper artifacts
90s talk-track clips (MP4): for Sales reps to share in outreach
Release-notes TL;DR (single paragraph) for email/LinkedIn announcements
Playbook checklist for CS onboarding calls (5-step)

notes: Trade-offs: We are intentionally keeping the battlecard micro (1 page) to increase adoption in the field; more detailed techno-decks remain in Drive. Demo scripts prioritize low-friction setup (no model uploads, use hosted demo model) to avoid infra flakiness during calls. If ENG-20894 slips, release-note paragraph will be revised to avoid technical claims. Metrics to track post-launch: number of pilots started, average time-to-first-API-call after outreach, and feedback sentiment from CS tickets.
